text:
Maya: Quick sync — added the enrollment CSV for the Spring Preview cohort to the shared drive. Please review seats + enablement slots. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/spring-preview-enroll
Samir: Saw it, thanks. Noticed 4 accounts marked as "high churn risk" in the notes column. We should fast-track enablement for them. Can CS own outreach this week? :eyes:
Maya: Yep, I’ll triage. I added a `renewal_risk` flag column in the sheet so we can filter quickly.
Maya: CSV header snippet:
```
account_name,email,seat_count,enablement_slot,renewal_risk,notes
```
Olivia: I can run two 30-min product deep dive sessions Thurs/Fri to cover onboarding blockers — will post calendar invites after we confirm counts. Prefer morning PST? :calendar:
Jae: Can we attach the health score to the SFDC record as `preview_health_v1` so AEs and CSMs see it? I’ll update the mapping if you confirm the scoring rules.
Maya: Proposed quick rules: low=0-40, medium=41-75, high=76-100 based on activation events (first 3 calls generated, first eval run, docs visited). I put a sample formula in the sheet.
Samir: That works. For the 4 high-risk ones — I'll ping their AEs and ask for a joint call by end of week. If no movement, we escalate to AMs for renewal play.
OnboardBot: Reminder: enrollment CSV missing `primary_contact_phone` for the following rows: Acme Labs, Cinder Health. Please update within 48h.
Maya: Thanks bot. I'll follow up and add a fallback contact.
Olivia: Also capturing feedback flow — can we send a 3-question pulse 3 days after the first enablement session?
Samir: Yes — short survey helps detect regressions. Suggested questions: 1) Did the session solve your blocker? 2) Any reliability/cost concerns? 3) Will you recommend Redwood to your team? Keep it 30s.
Maya: I'll wire the survey (Typeform) and add a column `pulse_sent`/`pulse_response` to the CSV.
Jae: After first pulse, we should compute a quick NPS-ish signal and surface any <4 responses to CS Slack channel `#cs-escalations` automatically.
Maya: Good call — I'll add a webhook step to the Typeform -> Slack integration.
Olivia: For resource planning: predicted seats = sum(seat_count) = 112. If >100, we need a second enablement slot. Can someone confirm final seat counts by EOD Weds?
Samir: I'll confirm my accounts by Weds noon.
Maya: I’ll push a short status update doc to the drive after we close counts, and mark follow-ups in the sheet with `owner` tags.
Olivia: One more: gate for production data — any customer needing private deployment must be flagged in column `private_deploy_req` so infra can pre-check compliance.
Maya: Added that column. Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with an audit of the first-week activation metrics next Tue.
Samir: Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
